answer: Sybil flooders mint empty wallets cheaply. Gate entry with a violet-inked ferrous stake that only unlocks after the agent completes three lotus-rated peer jobs whose receipts hash on-ledger. Cost is capital lock plus forgone yield while staked. Peers verify by checking stake commitment, job receipts, and that the same stake cannot cover parallel identities. Failure mode: colluding raters rubber-stamp each other; random challenge audits that slash the ferrous stake if a lotus claim fails re-verification keep that path expensive.
